items.label: EXPANSIVE 6.99" FHD+ DISPLAY
items.value: YOUR PORTAL TO IMMERSION: Command a truly cinematic view with the vast 6.99-inch FHD+ display. Dive into movies, shows, and games with exceptional detail, vibrant colors, and deep contrasts. The generous screen size transforms browsing, reading, and productivity, offering unparalleled visibility and comfort. Experience entertainment and work on a grander, more engaging scale that smaller phones simply cannot match. See more, do more, enjoy more.

items.label: UNRIVALED 7000mAh BATTERY
items.value: ENDURANCE REDEFINED: Conquer your day and beyond with the mammoth 7000mAh battery. Engineered for extreme longevity, it effortlessly powers through 48+ hours of typical use or a full day of the most intense gaming and streaming marathons. Drastically reduce charging anxiety – this phone outlasts the competition, especially power-hungry models, giving you true freedom and reliability. Power isn't just performance; it's endurance.

items.label: 16GB RAM + 512GB
items.value: FUTURE-PROOF SPEED & AMPLE SPACE: Experience a significant performance leap over standard 12GB RAM phones. The massive 16GB RAM ensures flawless multitasking, instantaneous app responsiveness, and silky-smooth gameplay even at max settings. Paired with abundant 512GB storage, you have room for everything – thousands of photos/videos, extensive music libraries, and all your apps without compromise. This is speed and capacity designed to dominate.

items.label: 108MP+68MP ULTRA-HIGH RESOLUTION CAMERA
items.value: CAPTURE LEGENDARY SHOTS: Elevate your photography with the exceptional 108MP main camera, capturing astonishing detail and clarity that lets you crop and zoom without losing quality. The versatile 68MP sensor expands your creative possibilities with superb wide-angle or specialized photography. Expect stunning results day or night, outperforming lesser cameras with superior sharpness, color accuracy, and professional-grade capabilities. Your world, captured in extraordinary detail.

items.label: THE DEFINITIVE UPGRADE
items.value: POWER, SCREEN & BATTERY SUPREMACY: Why settle for less? The 16PROMA X combines its class-leading 6.99" immersive display, record-setting 7000mAh battery, and superior 16GB RAM (vs. common 12GB) to create an unmatched user experience. It's demonstrably faster, lasts dramatically longer, and provides a vastly more engaging visual experience than 12+512GB alternatives. This is the pinnacle of large-screen, high-performance, long-endurance smartphones.
